Finite E[D+] by itself cannot control E[D+/WC]; exact Holder/Cauchy-Schwarz and threshold truncation supply necessary bounds, not a M9 population certificate.
counterhypothesis: If M9 self-financing, admission reserve caps, and time horizon yield a quantitative deterministic lower WC bound or inverse-moment bound and a native-vs-causal exposure/execution discrepancy moment, the P9E gap might still be certified. Without those source-specific lemmata no impossibility result follows.
